title: Chapter 5: The exponential and logarithmic functions

questions.stem: Hence find the equation of the tangent to \(y=\log_3 x\) at \(x=1\).
questions.hint: Use change of base and standard forms for \(\log_a\) and \(a^{x}\).

steps.work: We are asked to evaluate the expression step-by-step. First, identify the operations and any necessary common denominators or conversion method.

steps.explain: Final equation: \(y=\dfrac{x-1}{\ln 3}\). Why this step? It isolates one rule or evaluation so the next algebra stays exact. A common slip is confusing \(\log_a\) with \(\ln\), or dropping the chain-rule factor.
